455742.overview: Pacpacbird is an action game in which the player controls a bird. The bird can fly erratically across the fixed screen. The goal is to catch as many insects as possible. Insects will fly on the screen in different patterns and the game ends once 60 have spawned. Insects will also leave the screen after a while so the player must be quick to catch them. The game can be played with one or two players in four different game modes each.
